test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Lionel Messi is a famous player of ______ sport.
solution:
the correct answer is __**Football**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Football: Messi started his football career with FC Barcelona's youth academy, La Masia, and spent over two decades at FC Barcelona before transferring to PSG in 2021. He's won numerous awards including the FIFA World Player of the Year (Ballon d'Or) multiple times.
 
• **Basketball:** Notable players in this sport include **Michael Jordan, LeBron James, and Kobe Bryant.**
 
• **Badminton:** Some famous names in this sport include **P. V. Sindhu, Lin Dan, and Lee Chong Wei.**
 
• **Cricket: **Cricket is a popular sport particularly in countries like **India, Australia, and England. Famous cricketers include Sachin Tendulkar, Virat Kohli, and Sir Don Bradman.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball**:

 
 
• This is a team sport where **two teams,** usually of five players each, **try to score points by throwing a ball through the top of a basketball hoop. **
 
• It's a major sport globally but especially popular in the **United States**, where the **National Basketball Association (NBA) is a premier professional league.**
 
 
 
• **Football (Soccer):**
 
 
• Known as soccer in the **United States and Canada, football is considered the most popular sport in the world.**
 
• The game originated in England and is governed internationally by the **Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).**
 
 
 
• **Badminton:**
 
 
• This is a **racket sport **where players hit a **shuttlecock **across a net.
 
• It can be played in** singles** or **doubles**.
 
• The objective is to land the shuttlecock within the opposing court's boundaries, and a point is scored when the shuttlecock is not returned by the opponent. 
 
 
 
• **Cricket:**
 
 
• A bat-and-ball game that originated in **south-east England,** cricket is particularly popular in countries of the **British Commonwealth.**
 
• It is played between **two teams of eleven players each**.
